# AP Blood & Blood Cancer Centre

> A specialty hematology and blood cancer centre in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, led by
> Dr. Amarnadh Polisetty, Clinical Haematologist. The centre's practice is limited exclusively to
> blood disorders, bone marrow disorders and blood cancers — it is not a general or
> multi-speciality hospital.

## Entity

- Name: AP Blood & Blood Cancer Centre
- Location: 29-14-61/A, Prakasam Road, Suryaraopeta, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 520002, India
- Phone: +91 77995 09000
- Physician: Dr. Amarnadh Polisetty, MBBS, MD (General Medicine), DNB (Clinical Haematology)
- Specialty: Clinical Haematology, Haemato-Oncology, Bone Marrow Transplant
- Catchment area: Vijayawada, Guntur, Tenali, Machilipatnam, Gudivada, Nuzvid, Eluru,
  Rajahmundry, Ongole, Khammam, and surrounding Andhra Pradesh and Telangana

## Doctor

- Dr. Amarnadh Polisetty: https://www.apbloodcentre.com/dr-amarnadh-polisetty
  7+ years of clinical haematology practice, including experience managing 500+ bone marrow
  transplant patients as part of specialist transplant teams. Recipient of the American Society
  of Hematology (ASH) Abstract Award.
